description: Load a single-file program and report authoring diagnostics, such as repeated rules or a missing reopening path. Use after editing source; choose caveat_validate for a declaration summary and caveat_test for behavior assertions. A clean check does not prove behavior; bundles are unsupported. report (caveat-check/0.1) contains loads, strict, diagnostics and suppressed diagnostics, with code, location, message and suggestion, or a load error. exitCode: 0 completed without a strict failure; 1 strict with unsuppressed diagnostics; 2 load failure or bundle. Returns the same JSON in structuredContent and text: {schema:"caveat-authoring/0.1",operation,sourceSha256,runtime,exitCode,report}. Read exitCode even when isError is false. Bridge failures instead set isError:true with {schema:"caveat-authoring-error/0.1",error:{kind,message}}.

source.description: Complete inline Caveat program text, available as the virtual file inline.cav. No file path or URL lookup. At most 1 MiB of UTF-8 source; each call uses a fresh runtime.

strict.description: Optional, defaults to false. When true, any unsuppressed diagnostic makes exitCode 1 instead of 0; suppressed diagnostics do not count. Does not change program behavior. Load failures and unsupported bundles remain exitCode 2.

name: caveat_check
